body.name: Randomized Gaussian sparse-margin class
body.construction: For each \((p,k,m,M,s,V)\in\mathfrak T\), \(\mathcal M_{p,k}(m,M,s,V)=\{P\text{ on }\{0,1\}\times\mathbb R^p\times\mathbb R^2:0<\pi<1,\ A\perp(X,Y_0,Y_1),\ (X,Y_a)\text{ is jointly Gaussian for every }a\in\mathcal I_2,\ \Sigma\in\mathbb S_{++}^p,\ mI_{|U|}\preceq\Sigma_{UU}\preceq MI_{|U|}\text{ for every }U\subseteq\{1,\ldots,p\}\text{ with }|U|\le2k,\ \min\{r_0(S),r_1(S)\}\ge s\text{ for every }S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,p\}\text{ with }|S|\le2k,\ \max\{v_0,v_1\}\le V\}\).
